g.aria-label: Matching the Inference Engine to the Serving Workload (Nov 2026)
Local Single-User Assistant · Offline Dataset Batch Scoring
Local: Ollama or LM Studio (llama.cpp GGUF) / MLX · Offline Batch: vLLM offline mode (max tok/$)
Single App API · Multi-User Interactive Chat & Agent Service
App API: vLLM behind auth/TLS proxy · Multi-User / Agents: vLLM or SGLang (RadixAttention tree)
